task_metadata.task_title: Independent Shadow Benchmark Reconciliation & Statistical Validation

D1_false_positives.ground_truth: 19/84 with centroid gate (r <= 2.5 px); 21/84 raw peak chi2; 20/84 under provisional tau=124.50

dilation_tradeoff_verdict.selection_rationale: 2px dilation achieves 64.4% false alarm suppression, reduces overall FPR to 3.20% (meeting < 5.0% mission budget), preserves 100% of detected central anomalies, incurs zero central aperture encroachments, and consumes only 3.79% sky area.
dilation_tradeoff_verdict.alternative_viable_operating_point: DILATION_1PX (for highly crowded fields where area cost is critical: FPR 4.20%, area 2.76%)

conclusions.scientific_conclusion: The physical mechanism of off-center stellar contamination leaking through the 31-pixel convolutional receptive field and being mitigated by catalog masking is solidly confirmed. However, real-world deployment efficacy depends directly on catalog completeness.
conclusions.engineering_conclusion: CatalogAwareSourceMasker implementation is reproducible, deterministic, polarity-consistent, preserves Level-2 defects, protects central apertures, and passes 100% of safety tests.
conclusions.production_conclusion: No production code, checkpoint, or threshold changes are authorized or justified. Masker should remain in shadow validation.
conclusions.readiness_conclusion: ASTROVISION scientific validation completeness increases from partial diagnostic (Task 4.14) to verified shadow engineering prototype (Task 4.16).
conclusions.next_recommendation: Phase 4 Task 4.17: Deep Gaia DR3 / 2MASS Crossmatch Catalog Ingestion for Full Evaluation Cohort Footprint.
